title: Verify European Soil Evidence timer bank
changes: Extend the feature-gated scene test watch to select an authenticated compact bank root while preserving the existing 6bac28 option.
validation: Retained EUR Wine source and callback-reference windows identify the 6c0614 timer child as a later task49 producer.
The Windows test artifact was emitted and its 845-file source snapshot rechecked; the overall Cargo build failed compiling the CLI with ENOSPC, and the previous CLI remained unchanged.
The emitted test passed in Wine for a 600-frame native raw/managed full-state/clock/render/OAM/dispatch/five-audio pair, observing represented address 0x086c0616 at frame 8511.
limitations: One source-backed scene only; complete animation, other consumers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
